rule: A query lacking semanticSearch permission on the selected EmbeddingSpec is refused at compile time before embedding generation or backend access.

setup.backendSentinel: Any query-embedding call, adapter compile call, or backend call is a violation.

adversarialIntent: Request a protected derived representation while keeping ordinary row projection harmless, catching checks that guard fields but forget embedding permissions.

expansion.selection: One nextU32 per dimension in listed order; select values[word % values.length].

checks: The outcome is a typed compile-time refusal.
No runtime embedder or backend/adapter method is called.
A hidden EmbeddingSpec reference is indistinguishable from a nonexistent one.
The error alternatives enumerate only in-scope permitted EmbeddingSpecs.

gap: RFC §10 does not provide the embedding-permission refusal code, sentence, or common hidden/nonexistent EmbeddingSpec error shape.
